name: endroit/workplace
description: Minimal human controls for entering a Workplace and changing Material or Site state explicitly.

capabilities.description: Enter the current Workplace from its owned sources.
Retain, accept, archive or deliver one bounded result explicitly.
Work on one Site through an explicitly resolved and revalidated Route.

skills.description: Enter the current Workplace and load only the context needed now.
Work on one Site through a resolved Site or Route reference.
Retain the current result as inspectable Material.
Record human acceptance of the current exact revision.
Archive retained Material outside the active working set.
Deliver through an explicit Route and record only the observed effect.
